commons.title: Klallam people at Port Townsend.jpg
commons.description: Watercolour by James Gilchrist Swan (1818–1900) of the Klallam people of chief Chetzemoka (nicknamed 'the Duke of York'), with one of Chetzemoka's wives (nicknamed 'Jenny Lind') distributing potlatch at Port Townsend, Washington, USA, now in the Yale Collection of Western Americana, Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library, Yale (Bibliographic Record Number 2003195)
commons.editorial_reason: Caption explicitly identifies Klallam people and their potlatch; the image visibly depicts the cultural gathering and distribution of goods.
